name: Sakaki Sei
source:
A girl in Izumi's class. Her father is the founder of a new religious sect called the "Rapture Law Society". Since she is the daughter of their leader, the believers call her "Child of God".
She is persistently and viciously bullied by other students, who call her "Demon" behind her back.
She has an autistic personality, and is very quiet.

[translated from [url=http://hadashi.product.co.jp/effect/char.html]official site[/url]]
